variants.headline: Home world changes the charter
variants.body: The home world has changed the colony's charter. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Colonial charter amended
variants.body: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
